title: Beetle Mage Ritual
description: A beetle-headed figure with antlers sits cross-legged on a mound of earth and candles in the center of a glowing magical circle. Multiple arms extend from its body, manipulating floating papers, golden rings, and scrolls, while hooded figures kneel around the outer circle in a dark, lantern-lit chamber.
prompt: A surreal dark fantasy scene of an anthropomorphic beetle with large antlers and a golden crown, wearing white robes and multiple golden necklaces. The figure has six arms and sits in a meditative pose atop a mound of dirt and lit candles. It levitates papers, scrolls, and golden rings around itself. The scene is set inside a large intricate magical circle on the floor with hooded cultists kneeling around it, dramatic rim lighting from hanging lanterns, particles and smoke in the air, high contrast black and gold color palette, detailed ink and watercolor style.
